title: Normal force magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the normal force using the equilibrium condition in the perpendicular direction, obtaining approximately 47.6 N.

title: Friction force magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the friction force using the equilibrium condition parallel to the incline, obtaining approximately 3.2 N.

title: Force decomposition
description: Important: Properly resolves both gravity and the applied horizontal force into components parallel and perpendicular to the inclined plane.

title: Equilibrium application
description: Important: Recognizes that the object is at rest and applies Newton's first law (sum of forces equals zero) in both directions along the incline.

title: Friction direction identification
description: Important: Correctly identifies that friction acts upward along the incline to oppose the net tendency of motion downward.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (Newtons) throughout the calculation and includes them in the final answer.

title: Sign error in components
description: Pitfall: Makes sign errors when resolving forces, particularly confusing sine and cosine for the applied force components.

title: Missing friction direction
description: Pitfall: Calculates only the magnitude of friction without specifying its direction along the incline.
